# pushward_org_domain_verification (Resource)

Waits until a `pushward_org_domain` is verified. Make it depend on the DNS record that publishes the domain's TXT record; creating it asks PushWard to look the record up, and asks again while the record is not visible yet or the lookup fails, until `timeouts.create` (10 minutes by default). A domain another organization verified first fails at once.

When PushWard sets the domain back to `pending` (seven missed daily checks in a row), this resource stays in the state, so whatever depends on it is not held up, and the domain's `status` shows `pending`. Fix the TXT record, then `terraform apply -replace=<address>` verifies the domain again. A removed domain drops this resource from the state. Destroying it changes nothing in PushWard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pushward_org_domain" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

# The TXT record, here in Route 53; a cloudflare_dns_record or any other DNS
# provider's record works the same way.
resource "aws_route53_record" "pushward" {
  zone_id = var.zone_id
  name    = pushward_org_domain.example.txt_name
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 300
  records = [pushward_org_domain.example.txt_value]
}

# Asks PushWard to look the record up until it shows, for up to 15 minutes.
# Should the domain lapse back to pending later, fix the record and run
# terraform apply -replace=pushward_org_domain_verification.example.
resource "pushward_org_domain_verification" "example" {
  domain_id = pushward_org_domain.example.id

  timeouts {
    create = "15m"
  }

  depends_on = [aws_route53_record.pushward]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The `pushward_org_domain` to verify. Changing it verifies the other domain.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The domain id.
- `org_id` (String) The organization the resource belongs to, that of the provider's org admin key when the resource was created or imported. An org admin key of another organization is an error, not a plan that creates the resource again there.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
